name: How do I choose the right color temperature for bathroom lighting?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right color temperature for bathroom lighting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right color temperature involves considering the desired mood and function. Warmer temperatures (around 2700K-3000K) create a cozy, inviting atmosphere, while cooler temperatures (3500K-4000K) offer brighter, more energizing light suitable for tasks like makeup application or shaving. Many homeowners prefer a neutral white (3000K-3500K) for a balanced look. Using dimmers can also provide flexibility.
acceptedAnswer.description: Select warmer temperatures (2700K-3000K) for a cozy feel, cooler (3500K-4000K) for task lighting, or neutral white (3000K-3500K) for balance.
